reviews.review: totally worth of the price, a nice co-op game!

Oh~ We are the valiant infantry. We are the alpha team with passion and camaraderie.

Hear us as we shout at the top of our lungs. Be calm, be bold and raise your guns.

It's only with our sacrifice, that mankind can still exist down here in paradise.

To defend our dearest Mother Earth, we're ready to give up our lives!

High up in the air our comrades fight, dashing through the sky now like a million bolts of light.

We shall spread our wings wide and fly high. Soaring, gilding through the endless sky.

Now we will invade the underground. Wiping out the giant monsters. Crush them one by one.

Deep into the darkness marching on. We fear no danger, we stay strong.

Now pick up our weapons, off we go. Firing at the flying saucers, shooting down our foe.

We shall not allow these aliens, to rule we ♥♥♥♥ sapiens.

Fight deep down into the deepest caves. Fighting off the monsters as they come wave after wave.

Please don't send us on these grave missions. We're done with these expeditions.

Farewell my comrades the time has come. Its over now my love, and my family are all gone.

Here still I will fight the endless scream. There's no one home to wait for me.

Abandoned by my friends and family. Alone in the city surrounded by the enemy.

Why should I still keep on fighting on? Shooting monsters dead from dust till dawn.

This city has nothing but despair. All we hear is silence now cause not a soul was spared.

Yet, we still keep fighting the good fight. We trample our foes day and night.

Now hold up your head and laugh and taunt. On the front we are the brave heroes and we fight on.

Stand shoulder to shoulder now brave friends. We will storm ahead until the end.

So you're reading this thinking if you want the game?
Well giant robots vs giant bugs is an option, maybe you like anime booba well thats also an option. Oh? You wanna play armored core? Say no more this games got somthing for everyone.

EDF This.  Just an incredible, stupid amount of repetitive, mind-numbing grinding.  You can't get top level gear unless you buy the DLC mission packs, and you'll want that max level gear to deal with the fury-inducing, stun-locking, instant-agro, 20-story dodge-rolling-alien, pile of masochistic self-loathing that is EDF5.  Go do something more fun, reasonably priced, less time-consuming, and more productive with your life, like bashing your head with a brick.  If you're looking for a challenge where skills make the difference, then look elsewhere.  This is a dlc-dependent grindfest, plane and simple.
